content: The CRF layer is responsible for predicting the tag INLINEFORM0 of a token at each timestep, as shown in crf. The layer receives a sequence of virtual logit vectors ( INLINEFORM1 ) as input and then decodes them to a sequence of tags INLINEFORM2 using the Viterbi algorithm. DISPLAYFORM0
